# CONFORMANCE FIXTURES: the iterating methods and their lambdas (spec 6.4).
# One expression body, one level of iteration, parameters ride by position.

== map transforms each element
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.Map(v => v * 10).Sum()
want Num 60

== map may take the index
env temps: List(Num) = [5, 5, 5]
expr temps.Map((v, i) => v * i).Sum()
want Num 15

== map to text re-homes each result
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2]
expr temps.Map(v => Str(v) + "s").Join(",")
want Text "1s,2s"

== filter keeps what passes
env temps: List(Num) = [5, 15, 25]
expr temps.Filter(v => v > 10).Sum()
want Num 40

== filter keeps the element shape for the chain
env temps: List(Num) = [5, 15, 25]
expr temps.Filter(v => v > 10).First()
want Num 15

== any finds a witness
env temps: List(Num) = [5, 15]
expr temps.Any(v => v > 10)
want Bool true

== any finds none
env temps: List(Num) = [5, 6]
expr temps.Any(v => v > 10)
want Bool false

== all holds
env temps: List(Num) = [11, 12]
expr temps.All(v => v > 10)
want Bool true

== all breaks
env temps: List(Num) = [11, 2]
expr temps.All(v => v > 10)
want Bool false

== sortBy orders by the key
env temps: List(Num) = [10, 30, 20]
expr temps.SortBy(v => -v).Join(",")
want Text "30,20,10"

== sortBy over text keys
env names: List(Text) = ["bb", "a", "ccc"]
expr names.SortBy(v => v.Length()).Join(",")
want Text "a,bb,ccc"

== reduce folds with its starting value
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.Reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 10)
want Num 16

== reduce may take the index
env temps: List(Num) = [10, 20, 30]
expr temps.Reduce((acc, v, i) => acc + v * i, 0)
want Num 80

== a text fold re-homes its accumulator
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.Reduce((acc, v) => acc + Str(v), "")
want Text "123"

== an empty list folds to its start
expr [].Reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, 7)
want Num 7

== the chain composes
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2, 3, 4]
expr temps.Filter(v => v % 2 == 0).Map(v => v * v).Sum()
want Num 20

== iteration is wire-legal when the result folds
tier wire
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2, 3]
expr temps.Filter(v => v > 1).Sum()
want Num 5

== a mapped list is one scalar short of the wire
tier wire
env temps: List(Num) = [1, 2]
expr temps.Map(v => v * 2)
error one scalar

== a lambda may not nest
env rows: List(Num) = [1]
expr rows.Map(v => [v].Map(w => w))
error another lambda

== x is out of scope inside a body
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map(v => x)
error not in scope

== x cannot name a parameter
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map(x => x)
error cannot name a lambda parameter

== a parameter may not shadow a variable
env limit: Num = 5
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map(limit => limit)
error shadows a variable

== parameters need distinct names
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Reduce((v, v) => v, 0)
error named twice

== the body is one expression
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map(v => v, 2)
error ONE expression

== the arrow is not optional
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map(v)
error expected '=>'

== the head is a name
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map(2 => 2)
error parameter name

== filter wants a condition
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Filter(v => v + 1)
error condition

== all wants a condition
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.All(v => v + 1)
error condition

== sortBy wants an orderable key
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.SortBy(v => v > 0)
error number or text

== reduce needs its starting value
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Reduce((acc, v) => acc + v)
error starts from

== reduce folds to one value
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Reduce((acc, v) => [v], 0)
error folds to ONE value

== the fold stays one shape
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Reduce((acc, v) => acc + v, "zero")
error stay one shape

== map takes at most the element and the index
env temps: List(Num) = [1]
expr temps.Map((a, b, c) => a)
error lambda parameters

== a number has no map
env setpoint: Num = 5
expr setpoint.Map(v => v)
error has no method 'Map'
